supersedes.reason: Scientific correction: KLIFS defines 85 alignment columns, some of which are explicit gaps and do not correspond to physical residues.

frozen_site_definition.alignment_system: KLIFS fixed kinase pocket alignment columns 1-85
frozen_site_definition.reference_domain: reviewed human UniProt canonical wild-type core kinase domain
frozen_site_definition.gap_policy: Preserve an explicit 85-column gap mask; require a unique monotonic canonical mapping and exact amino-acid/coordinate validation for every non-gap column.

coordinate_materialization.predicted_source: AlphaFold Protein Structure Database canonical monomer v6 mmCIF

shared_requirements: exact wild-type amino acid at every non-gap KLIFS column
no non-water foreign heavy atom within 8.0 angstrom of any pocket heavy atom

strict_global_zero_nonpolymer.additional_rule: zero non-polymer entities anywhere in the deposited entry

binding_site_unoccupied.additional_rule: remote non-polymers are permitted; ligand identity is not used for selection

edge_union: aligned KLIFS85 sequence identity at least 0.70
maximum length-normalized AlphaFold-pocket US-align TM-score at least 0.75

information_boundary.holo_view_role: forbidden in primary; sensitivity-only if separately admitted
